My Tech Stack

System Administration

Windows Administration

Full lifecycle of Windows (7–11) maintenance: OS installation and configuration, driver and software setup, troubleshooting and error resolution, updates, BIOS/UEFI configuration, BitLocker, and remote access (RDP).

Linux

Basic Linux administration: system installation, GNOME environment configuration, and user software setup for business tasks.

Hardware Maintenance

Comprehensive hardware maintenance: diagnostics, cleaning, thermal paste replacement, repair, and upgrades of PCs, laptops, all-in-one systems, and POS terminals.

Thin Clients

Deployment and configuration of thin clients on Windows and Linux: connection to remote work environments (RDP), user environment setup and optimization.

Mobile Terminals & Barcode Scanners

Configuration, firmware updates, and maintenance of mobile terminals: working with Windows and Android devices, integration with corporate systems (RDP), software installation, and basic hardware repair.

Printers & Thermal Printers

Deployment and maintenance of printers and thermal printers: connection and configuration (USB/network), driver installation, troubleshooting, and integration with MyQ and internal systems.

Video Surveillance

Configuration of video surveillance systems: IP camera setup, working with NVRs, system configuration and monitoring in iVMS.

Access Control Systems (UProx / StopNet)

Configuration and administration of access control systems: controller setup, access and group management, card issuance, system monitoring, and reporting.

Telephony (DECT / IP)

Installation and configuration of DECT and IP phones, troubleshooting, and user support.
